I am writing this letter to let you know that an extraordinary event happened:
we have a Quarto template/extension for EUROCONTROL letterhead!

This has not been an easy endeavour but with the help of `StackOverflow` 
we managed to get something working.

 



## How to use it

You can use this extension as a template to create a letter.
This is following the official letterhead setup of EUROCONTROL.

To do this, use the following command:

```bash
quarto use template eurocontrol/quarto-letter
```

This will install the extension and create an example `qmd` file that you can
use as a starting place for your letter.


**NOTE**: please note that after the creation of your letter `qmd` file,
the `signature.png` file will be copied from the 
`_extension` folder.
This is the scan of the signature; please replace it with
yours and/or adapt the YAML accordingly.
You can avoid to include a scanned signature altogether by
simply removing the `signature:` line in the YAML.
 



## Installation for existing document

You may also use this format with an existing Quarto project or document.
From the quarto project or document directory, run the following command to
install this format[^1]:


```bash
quarto install extension eurocontrol/quarto-letter
```

[^1]: this is a footnote...
